kind: authenticated source blocks; final device sample versus saved official-source diagnostic baseline
authorization: Implement imported-book block verification and flash/debug hardware; reuse saved baseline, no formal release.

protocol.reset: Host RTS hard reset before each measured book, after OTA VALID qualification. Not physical power cycling.
protocol.home: Wait successful home display/status, blank-area taps 10,10 separated by 400ms; wait 200ms; tap second recent 300,890.
protocol.next: First right key at reader-ready receipt plus 3 host seconds.
protocol.prev: Left key one second after NEXT request/display wait completes.
protocol.screenshot: Capture panel-reference digital image only after NEXT/PREV; compare returned original page.
protocol.timing: Device synthetic-input start to successful display job completion; ready receipt separately reported. Not optical, physical touch, or host roundtrip.
protocol.cache: Final books have authenticated block tables established by one initial full-source import. Baseline has no block tables. Shao baseline resume_hits=0, final OPEN/PREV hits=2; Ming baseline OPEN/NEXT/PREV hits=3, final OPEN/PREV hits=2 with NEXT served by warmed RAM. Existing caches retained, not restored to byte-identical snapshots.
protocol.earlier_failed_checks: One Shao check exposed synchronous optional index binding; one Ming check exposed optional writer admission blocking input. Both were rejected and preserved. No baseline repeats. Final a30b816e1 sampled once per book, Shao then Ming.

verification_model.first_import: Full original-file SHA, capturing every block hash from the same sequential read; no second source scan.
verification_model.later_open: Authenticate the complete table against the internal root, then fully hash used blocks and cache dependency resources before consumption. Never register a whole-file proof.
verification_model.unread_corruption: May be detected only when the corresponding block is read; not a new whole-file verification before first body.
verification_model.fallback: Missing/corrupt table or root, over-size source, or optional OOM falls back to complete original-source verification. Opening detects changed used bytes and reimports completely before accepting a new identity.
